_readme: Rolls individual store records up into one parent in the Analytics dropdown. Rules are checked top to bottom; first match wins. 'startsWith' ignores case, punctuation and extra spaces. After the rules, autoStrip trims store numbers and ' - Location' suffixes (e.g. "Trudy's Hallmark #100" -> "Trudy's Hallmark"). Names that match nothing stay as their own entry. Edit, commit, and the next directory refresh (or ?refresh=true) picks it up.
